title: Mutation timing; accumulation; and selection in the male germline shape inheritance risk for developmental disorders.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement, no accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. One web search found the medRxiv preprint, which states raw WGS (whole-genome sequencing) and NanoSeq (duplex sperm sequencing) data go to EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive) under controlled access.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Cohort sizes (167 trio families, 127 fathers' sperm, 6 early mosaic fathers) are from the abstract; the controlled-access statement is from the search snippet of the preprint; I did not open any data file.

a1_downloadable.note: Human patient sequencing deposited in EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive) under controlled access, needing a data access committee application; paper itself is not open access in Europe PMC. Not checked beyond search snippet.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No obvious label column; any target (e.g. sperm variant allele fraction, mosaic status) would be derived from variant calling on the controlled raw data. Not verified in files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs would be raw reads or variant calls behind controlled access; nothing inspected.

a5_enough_rows.note: Unit of analysis is the family/father: 167 trios, 127 sperm samples, 6 early mosaics per the abstract — far below 400 for classification.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; raw WGS/duplex sequencing is many GB to TB

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Abstract says 167 families; preprint snippet says 168 trios — minor mismatch, unresolvable without files.

a8_label_provenance.note: Mutations are physical measurements from sequencing, not model outputs, but unreachable.

honest_claim_h3: With ~127 fathers and 6 mosaic carriers, no model could claim more than describing this cohort, and the data needed is controlled access.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a father's sperm mutation profile and age to predict his risk of passing a new disease-causing mutation to another child.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-father sperm sequencing summaries and child trio sequencing; about 127 fathers (from the abstract, not verified).
plain_idea.predict: Whether a father carries an early mosaic pathogenic variant, or his recurrence risk, measured by duplex sequencing of sperm.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Genetic counsellors could estimate recurrence risk per family, but with 6 positive fathers and controlled-access data this is not feasible.

ml_idea: Considered predicting paternal mosaicism / recurrence risk from sperm mutation burden; dead on controlled access and tiny n.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Confirm the EGA datasets need a data access committee application (they do, per preprint).

verdict_reason: A1 fails: human trio and sperm sequencing is controlled access in EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive); also A5 fails, with ~127 fathers and only 6 mosaic carriers per the abstract.
